metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the horn at twopence, Navarre at two, and twenty-four lines in two days.

yesterday: The Sunday letter is still folded. Thursday's carrier still has it. Your father is mending.
The horn is filled, at twopence. Yesterday's spoon was the measure.
Garnish's tally is twenty-four lines in two days. Thirteen of them were today.
In the morning James Burbage wants you at the Theatre at ten of the clock, on the north side.
